mapper.select: SELECT id, status_code AS statusCode, min_idle_days AS minIdleDays, max_idle_days AS maxIdleDays, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_active AS isActive FROM customer_activity_rule WHERE status_code = #{statusCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, status_code AS statusCode, min_idle_days AS minIdleDays, max_idle_days AS maxIdleDays, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_active AS isActive FROM customer_activity_rule ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_activity_rule (status_code, min_idle_days, max_idle_days, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{statusCode}, #{minIdleDays}, #{maxIdleDays}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_activity_rule SET status_code = #{statusCode}, min_idle_days = #{minIdleDays}, max_idle_days = #{maxIdleDays}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
